MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE
Off Calendar Jul-16-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo, CSR: Mary Hinds.
Appearances:
Alan Horwitz, Esq. for Plaintiff T&S Realty, Mr. Clark the Property Manager,also present. Defendant: Ariana Shapiro, present in pro per, also in behalf of her husband Vern Johansen.
Terms of the ORAL settlement were read into the record as follows:
Defendants to make payments for back rent:
$1,225.00 on or before July 30, 2003
$1,225.00 on or before August 13, 2003
Starting on September 2003, to pay on the 5th day of each month $1,225.00 as rent plus
$1,675.00 back rent in installments of $500.00 due on the 20th of each month until paid in full.
If the defendant complies the case will be dismissed with prejudice and defendants will be reinstated as good tenants.
If defendants do not comply with the agreement, plaintiff may so state by ex parte declaration, with (24) hours notice to the defendant and have judgment entered.
Plaintiff counsel to reduced it in writing for defendants signature.
All parties agreed to the settlement in open court.
The Court deemed the matter settled and trial date is vacated.
